== Biography ==
Wesley Guynn Glasgow was born about 1818 in Tennessee, United States.

== Research Notes ==
=== Current Maryland and Smith County review, 23 October 2026 ===

'''New possible father: unknown → James Glasgow-2492, 35%.''' Select James Glasgow-2492, the older Smith County householder, as Wesley Guynn Glasgow-2476’s possible working father. Their maintained accounts cite James in Smith County in 1820 and 1840 and the younger Wesley/Neely household there in 1850. James’s approximate 1776 birth makes him about 42 at Wesley’s estimated 1818 birth, a comfortable direct generation. The older James is a specific existing local household, not an invented parent. This is the leading bounded catalogue comparison for the disconnected Wesley family; its same-county chronology is more specific than an otherwise unplaced Tennessee or Scottish Glasgow.

35% is a subjective, low-confidence estimate for the complete father-profile hypothesis. No inspected record calls Wesley James’s son, places them in one household, transfers land between them, or names Wesley’s parents. The cited 1820/1840/1850 census images and age-band counts were not newly inspected; FamilySearch required a security challenge and the linked Ancestry record required membership. Wesley’s memorial has no parent links, dates or photograph beyond an approximate birth/death note; it is not independent parent proof. Wesley’s identification with the indexed Neely and James’s earlier North Carolina ancestry are separate propositions. An uncle or other collateral relationship, another local James, an unrepresented father, and William-2130 (broad Tennessee context without a held Smith County association) remain alternatives. No mother is selected and no relative is moved solely because of a name, naming custom or Y-DNA premise.
